summary: 065 resolves the canonical-Explore chronology finding and proves that pre-prepare readiness ordering is technically composable. It does not yet prove an already-owned contract-consistent execution seam: the proposed trusted host executes product archive Guidance HOW before invokeSingleAction and therefore before exact ActionPackage formation, conflicting with the accepted Action Guidance execution identity contract. Proposal must wait until this ownership/order contradiction is closed without introducing a new Action/state/control plane.
